checks.name: logic_errors_explicitly_corrected
checks.value: The fact that R35 produced safe bridges does not imply that making those bridges taller will solve the visual cluster problem; amplitude and topology are different variables. It also does not justify global mask closing, because a visually convenient join may be a real drainage break. R36 therefore changes continuity scale only, keeps the inherited stair frame/amplitude fixed, and requires same-family two-sided contour support before any larger stitch can appear.
checks.limit: reject taller-riser and unrestricted closing shortcuts

checks.name: real_world_constraint_is_explicit
checks.value: real terrace continuation, branch and merge locations cannot be reconstructed quickly from the present 12.5 m macro DEM and photographs. Selected-field metre/sub-metre microtopography, surveyed riser/bund/channel sections, management boundaries, inlet/outlet sill elevations and event water-management records are still absent. These stitches are synthetic morphology candidates, not surveyed Yunnan terrace junctions.
checks.limit: state missing real-world evidence that blocks fast reconstruction

checks.name: xiaoma_truth_boundary_retained
checks.value: the Xiaoma/TLO intake still marks field location/boundary, sampling window, field microtopography, bund section, channel section and water-control elevation unknown. Contour continuity does not establish ownership, hydraulic connectivity, head, water depth, discharge or gate state; R36 creates none of those states.
checks.limit: no contour-continuity -> hydraulic-truth error

checks.name: mrrolord_ordering_only
checks.value: the saved MrRolord frame audit is used for ordering only: drainage hierarchy -> accumulated terrain influence -> terrain valleys/benches -> terrain-conforming land use. R36 keeps the inherited hydrology-first hard exclusions and deterministic world-space geometry; Blender dimensions, Voronoi cells, shader displacement and adaptive subdivision are not copied as agricultural truth.
checks.limit: process ordering only

checks.name: user_reference_reopened_without_metric_inference
checks.value: image(173).png was reopened this round. R36 uses only visible morphology: long curved contour-following benches form nested families, can reconnect locally, and still preserve narrow drainage interruptions. No metric terrace width, stitch length, riser height, channel size, water depth or hydraulic parameter is inferred from the image.
checks.limit: morphology only
